arguments.value: David Alan Ezra (born 1947) is a senior United States district judge for the District of Hawaii, appointed by President Ronald Reagan in 1987 and confirmed in 1988. A native of Columbus, Ohio, he earned his B.B.A. and J.D. from St. Mary’s University in Texas, served in the U.S. Army Reserve, and began his legal career with a clerkship in Honolulu followed by private practice there from 1972 to 1988. He has also served as an adjunct professor at the William S. Richardson School of Law and was chief judge of the district court from 1999 to 2005, later assuming senior status in 2012.
